mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT sp.stock_code, sp.trade_date, sp.close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sp.stock_code ORDER BY sp.trade_date DESC ) AS rn FROM stock_price_daily sp INNER JOIN stock_master sm ON sm.stock_code = sp.stock_code WHERE sm.market_type = #{marketType} AND sm.is_active = 1 AND sp.close_price IS NOT NULL ), paired AS ( SELECT latest.stock_code, latest.close_price AS latest_close, previous.close_price AS previous_close FROM ranked latest INNER JOIN ranked previous ON previous.stock_code = latest.stock_code AND previous.rn = 2 WHERE latest.rn = 1 AND previous.close_price > 0 ) SELECT AVG((latest_close - previous_close) / previous_close * 100) FROM paired

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT sp.stock_code, sp.trade_date, sp.close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sp.stock_code ORDER BY sp.trade_date DESC ) AS rn FROM stock_price_daily sp INNER JOIN stock_master sm ON sm.stock_code = sp.stock_code WHERE sm.sector_name = #{sectorName} AND sm.is_active = 1 AND sp.close_price IS NOT NULL ), paired AS ( SELECT latest.stock_code, latest.close_price AS latest_close, previous.close_price AS previous_close FROM ranked latest INNER JOIN ranked previous ON previous.stock_code = latest.stock_code AND previous.rn = 2 WHERE latest.rn = 1 AND previous.close_price > 0 ) SELECT AVG((latest_close - previous_close) / previous_close * 100) FROM paired
